impact: Mixed for HOOD: strong deposits, margin and prediction-market growth, but crypto revenue is under pressure with bitcoin weak and assets slipped with the market.
summary: Robinhood's October operating data showed 28.9M funded customers, up about 130K from September, and net deposits of $15.1B, a 46% annualized growth rate. Total platform assets fell 3% month over month to $383B but are up 12% year over year. Crypto notional volume dropped 21% from September and 48% year over year to $17.0B, while event contracts rose 136% year over year to 5.9B and margin balances rose 4% to $22.9B. Equity volume was $325B, up 1%, and options contracts were flat at 289M.
title: Robinhood October: $15.1B net deposits, crypto volume down 21%
